30/S0.subgoal: Explain how sound is perceived at different levels (social, warning, and primitive).

30/S1.subgoal: Define psychophysics and psychoacoustics and describe Stevens' power law and JND.

30/S2.subgoal: Describe how Stevens' power law relates physical stimulus magnitude to perceived loudness.

30/S3.subgoal: Compare the chances of differentiating frequencies based on the sound frequency and JND.

30/S4.subgoal: Explain why sound localization is crucial for creating a better immersive experience in VR.

30/S5.subgoal: Define the parameters (azimuth, elevation, radius) used to describe a sound source's location.

30/S6.subgoal: Identify and describe the two main localization cues: interaural level difference and interaural time difference.

30/S7.subgoal: Explain how HRTF (Head-Related Transfer Function) models sound perception for accurate localization in XR systems.

30/S8.subgoal: Summarize the role of sound perception—including levels, loudness, pitch, and localization—in designing immersive XR experiences.
